# Portrait layout for Herdr

> A Herdr layout for vertical (portrait) monitors: spaces as columns with a tab and pane tree and agent states, a strip with a needs-you bell, a Files side panel with a floating nvim, and a tab bar. Two layouts and the mods they need. Apache-2.0. No network use.

Install by telling a Herdr agent: install https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout/blob/main/AGENTS.md): how an agent installs, adapts, tests and edits this repository safely, with the Herdr gotchas.
- [README](https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout/blob/main/README.md): what it is, requirements per OS, install by agent and by hand, keys, privacy, troubleshooting, uninstall.
- [RECIPE.md](https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout/blob/main/RECIPE.md): the build brief in Herdr's six-section format, with the disclosure of what runs and the list of names that must not change.

## Reference

- [Privacy summary in the README](https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout/blob/main/README.md#privacy) and [keys](https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout/blob/main/README.md#keys): what each mod reads, runs and writes; the keys to merge.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): checks, scratch Herdr home, what to do when Herdr updates or the bundled picker is re-synced.
- [NOTICE](https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout/blob/main/NOTICE) and [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): provenance of cloned, bundled and copied parts; changes per release.
- The same material as a rendered site (live after the repository is public and GitHub Pages is on): [overview](https://miguelalexanderdiaz.github.io/herdr-portrait-layout/), [install](https://miguelalexanderdiaz.github.io/herdr-portrait-layout/install.html), [platforms](https://miguelalexanderdiaz.github.io/herdr-portrait-layout/platforms.html), [privacy](https://miguelalexanderdiaz.github.io/herdr-portrait-layout/privacy.html), [how it works](https://miguelalexanderdiaz.github.io/herdr-portrait-layout/how-it-works.html), [troubleshooting](https://miguelalexanderdiaz.github.io/herdr-portrait-layout/troubleshooting.html).

## Files

- [layouts/portrait.json](https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout/blob/main/layouts/portrait.json) and [layouts/portrait-bottom.json](https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout/blob/main/layouts/portrait-bottom.json): the two layouts.
- [keys.json](https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout/blob/main/keys.json): keys to merge into the person's own.
- [mods/](https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout/tree/main/mods): bar-strip, portrait-tree, portrait-tabs, portrait-pane, portrait-files, nvim-float, attention-picker (bundled copy, read-only here).
- [snippets/vault-panel.json](https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout/blob/main/snippets/vault-panel.json): optional Vault panel node.

## Optional

- [Process notes of the improvement rounds](https://github.com/miguelalexanderdiaz/herdr-portrait-layout/tree/main/plans): audits and plans; not needed to install.
